text: Writing a custom compiler in Rust from scratch. Register allocation is absolute pain but the performance gains are worth every line of unsafe SIMD code.
Go Garbage Collection is amazing until you hit p99 latency spikes on a high-throughput network service. Tuned GOGC and memory arenas to flatline the latency graph.
Speculative decoding locally on mobile GPUs is a wild frontier. Getting 40 token/sec on old phone chips using custom WebGPU compute shaders.
